description: This file defines a Fragment for an Android application that displays PDF pages using PdfRenderer. It manages rendering PDF pages onto an ImageView and handles user interaction to navigate between pages.

classes.name: PdfRendererBasicFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays PDF pages using PdfRenderer, allowing navigation between pages.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, restores state, and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Opens the PDF renderer when fragment attaches to activity.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Closes the PDF renderer when fragment detaches.

methods.name: openRenderer
methods.description: Sets up PdfRenderer instance, copying PDF from assets if necessary.

methods.name: showPage
methods.description: Displays a specific PDF page on the ImageView.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Updates navigation button states and activity title based on current page.

methods.name: getPageCount
methods.description: Returns total number of pages in the PDF.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks to navigate pages.
